description: This file implements authentication-related API endpoints for the Focalboard server, including login, logout, registration, and password change, with route registration and session management.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API struct that contains methods for handling authentication routes and session management.

methods.name: registerAuthRoutes
methods.description: Registers authentication-related HTTP routes to the provided mux.Router.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login requests, authenticates user, and returns a token.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout requests, terminates session.

methods.name: handleChangePassword
methods.description: Handles requests to change a user's password.

methods.name: sessionRequired
methods.description: Middleware that attaches a session to the request context, requiring authentication.

methods.name: attachSession
methods.description: Attaches session information to the request context based on token or headers.

methods.name: adminRequired
methods.description: Middleware that restricts access to admin APIs to local unix connections.
